gloss: the whole story; full account from beginning to end

definitions.gloss: the whole story; full account; every detail from start to finish
definitions.explanation: Refers to the complete sequence of events or facts, from the very beginning to the very end, without omitting anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I told the whole story of the incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目撃|もくげき}していた→目撃する：20232_mokugekisuru⟧。
examples.english: She had witnessed everything that happened at the scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ→防犯カメラ：07137_bouhankamera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Because the security camera had recorded the entire accident from start to finish, the cause could be identified.

notes:
USAGE:
{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう} is a four-character compound (yojijukugo). Despite containing ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧ (one part), the expression means the complete story, not just a part. The ⟦{始終|しじゅう}→始終：04192_shijuu⟧ means "from beginning to end."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to tell the whole story)
- {一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see everything)
- {一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧ (to record the full account)
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう} (the complete account of an incident)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}: the whole story, full account (formal, emphasizes completeness)
- ⟦{顛末|てんまつ}→顛末：21967_tenmatsu⟧: the full story, circumstances (formal, written)
- ⟦{経緯|けいい}→経緯：02782_keii⟧: the details, how things developed (focuses on process)
